architecture: GRU shared state/backbone with separate B decoder installed after A-only curriculum
head_construction: W_rho = rho*W_base + sqrt(1-rho^2)*W_orth, with W_orth globally orthogonal to W_base and equal Frobenius norm; same W_rho across paired curriculum conditions
stage1_pass_rule_per_rho: expected negative mean span difference in all 5 families; exact family sign-flip p<=0.05
alignment_gradient_rule: (target-A_nat span at rho=1) - (target-A_nat span at rho=0) < 0 in all 5 families
predeclared_stage2_localization: if rho=0.5 passes target-vs-A_nat, test rho=0.25; otherwise test rho=0.75. Stage2 is threshold localization, not an independent confirmatory p-value.
compute_minimization: one seed per family; base and three A curricula trained once per family then reused across rho values
